item.title: AI in Gaming 2026: Procedural Content Generation and NPC Intelligence Explained
item.description: AI in gaming 2026 is no longer a future promise — it is the present standard. With 90% of game developers now using AI in their workflows and the AI gaming market valued at $4.54 billion and growing at a 33.57% CAGR toward $81.19 billion by 2035, machine learning is transforming every layer of how games are created and experienced, from procedurally generated infinite worlds to NPCs that hold genuine conversations and remember your choices.
